title: Solubility and Solubility Curves
summary: Saturated solutions, how temperature changes solubility, reading solubility curves and growing crystals.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 5: Exploring Mixtures and their Separation
Earlier NCERT: Is Matter Around Us Pure?

objectives: I can define solubility and saturated solution.
I can read and interpret solubility curves.
I can calculate the mass of crystals formed on cooling.
misconceptions: Stirring makes more solid dissolve in a saturated solution.
All substances dissolve more when heated by the same amount.
A saturated solution is always very concentrated.
